mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital decreases for corporate cash flows.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.0%, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, reducing near-term economic growth and corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Stronger quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) reflects robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy expands.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for GDPC1 predicting 60-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (2017=100) signals manufacturing weakness, reducing economic output and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100.0, 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5%), strong payroll growth (PAYEMS > 200k) indicates robust economic activity and rising consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 200k, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong residential construction and consumer confidence, supporting economic growth and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for HOUST predicting 20-day returns.
